# FAST TECH Engineering Services

> FAST TECH Engineering Services is an electrical engineering company in Pakistan, established in 2010, providing electrical products, industrial power solutions, electrical engineering services, UPS systems, batteries, voltage stabilizers, power supplies, cable trays, distribution boards, HT and LT overhead materials, lighting solutions, and related electrical equipment.

## Company

FAST TECH Engineering Services serves commercial, industrial, and infrastructure customers across Pakistan. The company specializes in electrical equipment supply, industrial power solutions, electrical engineering, UPS systems, electrical distribution, power protection, and related services.

FAST TECH provides products and engineering support for businesses requiring reliable electrical infrastructure, backup power, voltage regulation, electrical distribution, and industrial power equipment.

## Products

### Online UPS
https://fasttecheng.com/product-online-ups

Industrial and online UPS systems for backup power, power protection, and critical electrical loads. FAST TECH offers UPS systems for commercial and industrial applications.

### Dry Gel Batteries
https://fasttecheng.com/product-dry-gel-battery

Maintenance-free dry gel batteries for UPS systems, solar applications, telecom systems, and industrial backup power.

### Lithium Batteries
https://fasttecheng.com/product-lithium-batteries

Lithium battery solutions for backup power and energy storage applications.

### Servo Stabilizers
https://fasttecheng.com/product-servo-stabilizers

Single-phase and three-phase servo voltage stabilizers designed to regulate voltage and protect electrical equipment from voltage fluctuations.

### DIN Rail Power Supplies
https://fasttecheng.com/product-din-rail-power

AC-DC DIN rail power supplies for industrial automation, control panels, manufacturing systems, and electrical installations.

### Distribution Boards and Cable Trays
https://fasttecheng.com/product-panel-dbs-cable-trays

Electrical distribution boards, panel DBs, and cable tray solutions for commercial and industrial electrical installations.

### HT and LT Overhead Materials
https://fasttecheng.com/product-lt-ht-overhead

High-tension and low-tension overhead line materials and transmission hardware for electrical power distribution projects.

### Street Lighting
https://fasttecheng.com/product-street-lighting

LED street lights, flood lights, high bay lights, and panel lighting solutions for roads, commercial properties, industrial facilities, and outdoor applications.

### Automotive and Genset Filters
https://fasttecheng.com/product-automotive-filters

Oil, air, fuel, diesel, hydraulic, and panel filters for generators, automotive applications, and industrial machinery.
